entries.57519610143c1761: As a certified broadcasting holding company with broadcasting at its core, it states that under the new segment structure launched from the fiscal year ended March 2026, it will address priority issues. In the broadcasting-related business it aims to accelerate the integration of broadcasting and digital; in the system-related business it plans to capture demand for standardization of local government systems and support for migration to government cloud, and to turn its own products into stock businesses; in the real estate business it seeks effective use of owned assets; and in the Lifestyle Business it aims for growth in e-commerce and early establishment of full-scale operation of land-based salmon aquaculture.
entries.64ff70dc3651e40b: Broadcasting-related business is the main source of revenue; in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the newly established Lifestyle Business was added, broadening the revenue mix. entries.65189a01b201199d: A segment whose main business is the sale of television and radio programs and spot CM. Consolidated subsidiary RKB Mainichi Broadcasting Corporation handles broadcasting, and RKB CINC Co., Ltd. handles part of program production, industrial and public relations film production, and the dispatch of program production staff and clerical workers. Event planning and production are also included in this segment.
